name: ATT regulatory actions and alternatives
plain: Competition regulators are fining Apple over ATT, and Apple has agreed to change how it works in the EU.
meaning: France fined Apple 150M euros (March 2025), Italy 98.6M euros (December 2025). Germany's settlement (September 2026) points to an alternative EU prompt from iOS 27.2. Regulators say ATT favors Apple's own ads.

android.note: No equivalent; Android's AAID controls are in Settings.

ios.store_policy: ATT stays in most places; EU changes via DMA and competition decisions
ios.note: Do not rely on specific effective dates; check Apple's developer news.

limits.headline: Can show a different tracking prompt in the EU after Apple's regulator deals
limits.user_action: You tap Allow or Ask App Not to Track, which may look different in the EU
can: Ask you to allow tracking, as today
Show a new EU prompt later (reported for iOS 27.2)
Show a different EU prompt before Apple finishes its changes
cannot: Count on exact dates; check Apple's news
Work on Android; Android has its own Settings controls
Avoid regulator action so far; France fined Apple 150M euros and Italy 98.6M euros
limits.differs: iPhone only. Android has no matching prompt; you use the ad ID controls in Settings.

story.what_it_is: Regulators are fining Apple over its tracking prompt, and Apple has agreed to changes in the EU.
story.for_you: You may see a different tracking prompt in Europe soon. The new prompt may sit next to other choices, and apps may ask more than once.
story.for_makers: France fined Apple 150 million euros in March 2025 and Italy 98.6 million euros in December 2025. Germany's settlement in September 2026 points to an alternative design that other regulators may follow.

use_cases.example: An ad firm complains that Apple's rules were stricter for others than for its own ads.
A game maker would have to show a new style of consent in the EU and watch yes rates change.
A publisher hopes a new prompt will bring more consent for ads.
Privacy groups warn that a weaker prompt could bring back cross app tracking.
A measurement team prepares to run tests on the new prompt design.
A retailer plans a separate consent screen that fits both laws and the prompt.

story.android_note: Android is not directly affected, but Google also faces competition cases on ad data.
story.ios_note: The ATT prompt may change in the EU, with other regions to follow.

technical_bounds: Facts reported by press; check primary sources
